exampleSentences.en: Several local workshops manufacture custom bicycles by hand.
exampleSentences.zh: 幾家本地工坊以手工製造客製化自行車。

exampleSentences.en: Modern plants manufacture semiconductors in tightly controlled, dust-free environments.
exampleSentences.zh: 現代工廠在嚴格管控的無塵環境中製造半導體。

manufacture.mnemonicHint: manu- 是『手』，fact 是『做』：manufacture 原意是用手做，現代則多指工廠製造或大量生產。

exampleSentences.en: A mass of clouds covered the mountain.
exampleSentences.zh: 一大片雲遮住了山。

exampleSentences.en: The object’s mass remains constant even when gravity changes.
exampleSentences.zh: 即使重力改變，物體的質量仍維持不變。

mass.mnemonicHint: mass 有「聚成一大團」的畫面。

exampleSentences.en: This jacket is made from recycled material.
exampleSentences.zh: 這件外套由回收材料製成。

exampleSentences.en: The archive provides valuable material for historical research.
exampleSentences.zh: 該檔案館為歷史研究提供寶貴素材。

material.mnemonicHint: mater 母體 + ial：構成事物的材料。

measurable.chinese: 可測量的；可量化的；明顯到足以衡量的

exampleSentences.en: Regular walks made a measurable difference to my blood pressure.
exampleSentences.zh: 規律散步讓我的血壓出現了可測量的改善。

exampleSentences.en: The policy produced a measurable decline in household energy consumption.
exampleSentences.zh: 該政策使家庭能源消耗出現可量化的下降。

measurable.mnemonicHint: measure（測量）加上 -able（能夠……的），就是『能被測量的』；看到 measurable 就想像拿尺把成果的差距實際量出來。

exampleSentences.en: I stored the raw meat on the lowest shelf of the refrigerator.
exampleSentences.zh: 我把生肉放在冰箱最下層的架子上。

exampleSentences.en: Producing meat generally requires more land than growing an equivalent amount of plant protein.
exampleSentences.zh: 生產肉類通常比種植等量植物性蛋白質需要更多土地。

meat.mnemonicHint: meat 和 meet 同音；盤子裡的肉是 meat，碰面則是 meet。

exampleSentences.en: Despite the fancy decor, the restaurant served mediocre pasta.
exampleSentences.zh: 儘管裝潢華麗，那家餐廳的義大利麵卻很普通。

exampleSentences.en: A mediocre response may identify the problem without evaluating its broader consequences.
exampleSentences.zh: 平庸的作答或許能指出問題，卻不會評估其更廣泛的後果。

mediocre.mnemonicHint: mediocre 和 medium 都帶有『中間』的感覺：成績卡卡在中間，沒有糟到墊底，也完全稱不上出色，就是平庸。

exampleSentences.en: I have a meeting with my landlord after work.
exampleSentences.zh: 我下班後要和房東見面。

exampleSentences.en: The research team held a meeting to review the unexpected results.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究團隊召開會議，檢視出乎意料的結果。

meeting.mnemonicHint: meet 聚在一起，meeting 就是聚會或會議

exampleSentences.en: A sense of melancholy filled the room after the farewell.
exampleSentences.zh: 告別後一股憂鬱感瀰漫了房間。

exampleSentences.en: The melancholy tone of the novel reflects post-war disillusionment.
exampleSentences.zh: 小說憂鬱的基調反映了戰後的幻滅感。

melancholy.mnemonicHint: melan(black) + choly(bile) → 黑色膽汁（古代認為導致憂鬱）→ 憂鬱的

exampleSentences.en: The wine has a mellow flavor that improves with age.
exampleSentences.zh: 葡萄酒有醇和的風味，越陳越好。

exampleSentences.en: A mellow leadership style fosters creativity.
exampleSentences.zh: 溫和的領導風格促進創造力。

mellow.mnemonicHint: mellow 發音像「美好」→ 柔和的 → 醇和的

exampleSentences.en: Club members receive a monthly newsletter.
exampleSentences.zh: 俱樂部會員每月會收到電子報。

exampleSentences.en: Committee members disagreed over the proposed reforms.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會成員對提議的改革意見不一。

members.mnemonicHint: member 加 s，表示團體中的多位成員。

exampleSentences.en: This method makes the stain easier to remove.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個方法讓污漬更容易去除。

exampleSentences.en: The researchers adopted a mixed-method approach to data collection.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員採用混合方法蒐集資料。

method.mnemonicHint: method 是做事沿著 meta 路徑前進的方法。

exampleSentences.en: After waiting in wet shoes all afternoon, Leo felt miserable.
exampleSentences.zh: 穿著濕鞋等了一整個下午後，里歐覺得難受極了。

exampleSentences.en: Workers endured miserable conditions until the factory adopted basic safety standards.
exampleSentences.zh: 工人忍受著悲慘的環境，直到工廠採用基本安全標準。

miserable.mnemonicHint: 把 miserable 連到 misery（痛苦）：一個人被 misery 包住，冷、濕、累又無助，那種整體感受就是 miserable。

misfit.chinese: 不合群的人；與環境格格不入者

exampleSentences.en: At the formal dinner, Ben felt like a misfit in his hiking boots.
exampleSentences.zh: 在正式晚宴上，穿著登山靴的班覺得自己格格不入。

exampleSentences.en: Rather than dismissing the inventor as a misfit, the committee examined her unconventional proposal.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會沒有把這位發明家視為怪人而不予理會，而是審視了她非傳統的提案。

misfit.mnemonicHint: mis-（錯、不合）加 fit（適合）：像一塊放錯位置、怎麼都嵌不進拼圖的拼片，因此指與群體或環境格格不入的人。

exampleSentences.en: Wearing sunscreen helps mitigate the risk of skin damage.
exampleSentences.zh: 塗防曬霜有助於減輕皮膚損傷的風險。

exampleSentences.en: Governments must mitigate the economic impact of rising sea levels.
exampleSentences.zh: 政府必須減輕海平面上升的經濟影響。

mitigate.mnemonicHint: mit(mild) + ig + ate → 使變溫和 → 減輕

morbid.chinese: 病態的；對死亡或可怕事物過度著迷的

exampleSentences.en: Curiosity turned morbid when he began collecting photographs of fatal accidents.
exampleSentences.zh: 當他開始蒐集致命事故的照片時，那份好奇心變得病態。

exampleSentences.en: The novel's morbid imagery reflects a society preoccupied with disease and death.
exampleSentences.zh: 小說中病態陰森的意象，反映了一個沉迷於疾病與死亡的社會。

morbid.mnemonicHint: morbid 源自拉丁文 morbus（疾病）；想像注意力病態地黏在死亡與災難上，便能記住它不只是陰暗，而是『不健康地著迷』。

exampleSentences.en: We usually watch movies together on Friday nights.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們通常在星期五晚上一起看電影。

exampleSentences.en: The essay argues that movies can shape public attitudes toward history.
exampleSentences.zh: 這篇論文主張，電影能形塑大眾對歷史的態度。

movies.mnemonicHint: movie 加複數 s，記成多部電影

exampleSentences.en: I listen to music while cooking.
exampleSentences.zh: 我做飯時會聽音樂。

exampleSentences.en: Music can serve as a powerful marker of cultural identity.
exampleSentences.zh: 音樂可以成為文化認同的有力標誌。

music.mnemonicHint: music 與 musician 音樂家同族。
